verdict.rationale: Docs show broad API coverage of Riveter's core UI features—enrich, build datasets, scrape, quick_search, search_agent, webhooks, dry_run/cost estimation, and SDK access (riveter-docs-1,3,4,5,6,26,29)—suggesting most day-to-day UI actions can be done programmatically. However, features like project scheduling/monitoring for freshness (riveter-docs-13,23) and explicit dataset compilation flows aren't clearly tied to documented API endpoints, and the OpenAPI spec itself is unreachable (riveter-probe-2), so full UI/API parity isn't confirmed. missing for 10: explicit API support for scheduling/monitoring workflows, a public OpenAPI spec confirming full endpoint coverage, and any direct statement of 1:1 UI/API parity.
